summary: Road to VR reports that Sandisk will be the exclusive flash storage provider for Meta VR Glasses (Spring 2027, $1,300, 128GB internal), with official 'Made for Meta' microSD Express cards and USB-C flash drives. The cards support up to 1TB. Pricing and speed requirements for the Meta-branded products are unannounced. The author's take is that expandable storage lets Meta hold the entry price down amid high NAND flash costs.
speakers_or_authors: Road to VR staff writer (trade press journalism)
relevance_reason: Hardware accessory and storage news for a VR headset. It says nothing about AI agents, personal context, voice interfaces, or AI-driven interaction changes, so it is off-topic for the brief.
commercial_interest: None evident from the author. The news is a Meta and Sandisk partnership, and the details come from vendor-provided imagery and announcements.
older_event: No. The item reports a new announcement, though the product it concerns does not launch until Spring 2027.
